name: find_synonyms
description: Find synonyms for an English word using the Datamuse word API (rel_syn), ranked by the Datamuse similarity score, with a limit on how many come back (default 10). Returns each candidate word with its score. Answers what another word for a given term is when writing, editing, or paraphrasing English prose.

word.description: The word to find synonyms for

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

name: find_rhymes
description: Find words that rhyme with a given word, ranked by score.

word.description: The word to find rhymes for

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

name: find_related
description: Find words related to a given word by a specific relation type. Relation types: "syn" (synonyms), "ant" (antonyms), "rhy" (rhymes), "trg" (triggers/associated words), "jja" (adjectives for a noun), "jjb" (nouns for an adjective).

word.description: The word to find related words for

relation.description: Relation type: "syn" (synonyms), "ant" (antonyms), "rhy" (rhymes), "trg" (associated words), "jja" (adjectives for noun), "jjb" (nouns for adjective). Default: "trg"

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

name: autocomplete
description: Return word completions for a given prefix string using the Datamuse suggestion endpoint. Takes a prefix (e.g., "hel") and returns matching words ranked by score (e.g., "hello", "help", "helpless").

prefix.description: The prefix to autocomplete (e.g. "hel" returns "hello", "help", etc.)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

name: find_words
description: Advanced word search. Find words matching a combination of meaning, pronunciation, and spelling constraints.

meaning_like.description: Find words with meaning similar to this phrase (e.g. "ocean"). Accepts query, word, text as aliases.

sounds_like.description: Find words that sound like this word (approximate pronunciation)

spelled_like.description: Find words spelled like this pattern (use * as wildcard, e.g. "b*ttle")

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)
